outputs.name: allowedSrcFolders
outputs.description: A Set of source-folder names listed by this module. Consumers can consult it as a source-folder allowlist; this declaration itself does not inspect or validate paths.

outputs.name: allowedTestFolders
outputs.description: A Set of test-folder names listed by this module. Consumers can consult it as a test-folder allowlist; this declaration itself does not inspect or validate paths.

outputs.name: allowedRootTypeScriptFiles
outputs.description: A Set of root TypeScript file names listed by this module. Consumers can consult it as an allowlist for root TypeScript files; this declaration itself does not inspect or validate paths.

outputs.name: allowedDirectSrcFiles
outputs.description: A Set of file names listed by this module for direct placement under src. Consumers can consult it as an allowlist for those files; this declaration itself does not inspect or validate paths.
